Callback inference must decline contexts that do not identify a safe method
signature, and must not fall back to the enclosing call or edit dependencies.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.27

-- negative.go --
package negative

import (
	"example.com/hidden"
	"strings"
)

type S struct{}
type I interface{}
type P *S
type G[T any] struct{}

func noSignature(s S, i I, p P, n int, external strings.Builder, generic G[int]) {
	acceptString(s.field)                    //@quickfixerr("field", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	acceptAny(s.unknown)                     //@quickfixerr("unknown", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	x := s.assignment                        //@quickfixerr("assignment", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	var typed func(int) = s.typedAssignment  //@quickfixerr("typedAssignment", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	accept(i.iface)                          //@quickfixerr("iface", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	accept(p.pointer)                        //@quickfixerr("pointer", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	accept(n.basic)                          //@quickfixerr("basic", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	accept(external.Missing)                 //@quickfixerr("Missing", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	accept(generic.genericReceiver)          //@quickfixerr("genericReceiver", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	acceptExpression(S.expression)           //@quickfixerr("expression", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	accept(func(int) {}, s.excess)           //@quickfixerr("excess", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	acceptMany(s.slice...)                   //@quickfixerr("slice", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	_ = (func(int))(s.conversion)            //@quickfixerr("conversion", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	hidden.Accept(s.inaccessible)            //@quickfixerr("inaccessible", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	hidden.AcceptStruct(s.foreignField)      //@quickfixerr("foreignField", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	hidden.AcceptInterface(s.foreignMethod)  //@quickfixerr("foreignMethod", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	hidden.AcceptEmbedded(s.foreignEmbedded) //@quickfixerr("foreignEmbedded", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	_, _ = x, typed
}

func localTypes(s S) {
	type local int
	func(func(local)) {}(s.localParam)   //@quickfixerr("localParam", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	func(func() local) {}(s.localResult) //@quickfixerr("localResult", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
	var l local
	accept(l.localReceiver) //@quickfixerr("localReceiver", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
}

func typeParams[T any](s S) {
	func(func(T)) {}(s.freeTypeParam) //@quickfixerr("freeTypeParam", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
}
func returnValue(s S) func(int) {
	return s.returned //@quickfixerr("returned", re"has no field or method", re"found 0 CodeActions")
}
func accept(func(int))              {}
func acceptExpression(func(S, int)) {}
func acceptString(string)           {}
func acceptAny(any)                 {}
func acceptMany(...func(int))       {}
-- hidden/hidden.go --
package hidden

type private int

func Accept(func(private))                        {}
func AcceptStruct(func(struct{ field int }))      {}
func AcceptInterface(func(interface{ method() })) {}

type privateInterface interface{ Exported() }

func AcceptEmbedded(func(interface{ privateInterface })) {}
